design_quote: A prose ask with no command, link or file in it ("sign in on the preview"), unless FO lists it as a step.
design_section: Design / PRFAQ / What does this not catch?
reason: S5 enumerates fenced commands, HTTP(S) links and fences in named Markdown files. An explicit outgoing-message step list with Asked fields is a new format absent from the approved design; no such format was implemented.
residual_harm: FO can omit a plain-language instruction or an inline-code instruction from its record and still pass; these remain undetected under the routed scope.
new_cost: An unrecorded diagram or evidence fence in an ask holds until recorded or moved; no fence tag is exempt.
